reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and this is bisglycinate with no oxide, a dose on the box and a named lab report I can match to the batch number. The guarantee means I can try one box without much risk, even though I would rather have one capsule.
objection: Two capsules every day is a lot to swallow, and I want to open the lab report and check it is a real independent lab before I pay.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the page turned out to be missing, generic or not matching the batch number, I would not buy.
